description.value:
Red-quilled yahruda feathers grow and molt rapidly, unlike the long-term feathers of other yahruda. They are also sharp, flexible, and tailed, making them perfect ranged weapons.
For each long rest, you molt 4 feather needles (short, thin feathers) and 2 feather arrows (long, tailed feathers). Alternatively, you can forcibly pluck a number of your own feathers as a minor action, taking 1 chaos damage for every 2 feather needles or 1 feather arrow plucked.
Feather needles are equivalent to the Throwing Star weapon, and feather arrows are equivalent to arrows. Regardless, both types of feather ammo deal an additional +1 damage on hit. In addition, if feather ammo strikes a target the same turn that they're plucked (within 6 seconds), they deal an additional +1 damage.
Plucked feathers grow back over a long rest, and unused feather ammo soften into normal feathers, no longer being usable as weaponry.
